title: Tverberg's Partition Theorem, 1D Theorem, and Colorful 1D Theorem
summary: A complete, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Tverberg's Theorem (Helge Tverberg, 1966) in the distinct-point set formulation across dimensions d >= 1 (with d = 0, r > 1 cases vacuously satisfied due to Finset carrier capacity limits on Fin 0 -> ℝ) via the Sarkaria–Bárány Colorful Carathéodory reduction, the full 1D Tverberg theorem for arbitrary r via symmetric-rank pairing following Mulzer–Werner, and the 1-dimensional Colorful Tverberg Theorem for arbitrary r (Bárány–Larman–Pach 1992).
